summary: Independently verified THROUGHPUT_OVERLOAD_GUARD_CANDIDATE_V1 and promoted its exact patch into METABOLISM_POLICY_V1 with a CAS-safe update from the candidate's observed blob SHA. The durable replay at 2026-09-17T20:38:03.263Z measured 11 recent launches and 1 young active pin, correctly leaving the guard inactive; synthetic acceptance fixtures proved activation at 10 launches/6 young pins and inactivity at 10/3. Existing EXECUTION, VERIFY, RECOVERY, GUIDE_INTEGRATOR, GUIDE_RESCATE, GUIDE_CRITIC and existing GUIDE_PLANNER work remain selectable under active overload; only new GUIDE_PLANNER self-materialization is suppressed. Two earlier verifier runs failed closed due verifier mistakes and caused no policy mutation. Promotion commit 0cea627d2ff1eb8047335d738e9feaf138b81c6c changes only the exact candidate patch. No product /w authority was promoted.
